nodes.klam_ok.text.t: Raven nods slowly. "The mountains. A long way off. Good thing somebody told me before I started looking in the wrong place. Here's two coins for your trouble." He gets up and leaves without another word.

nodes.klam_test.options.[klam_t].text.t: Say the survivor went off towards the mountains.

nodes.klam_zle.text.t: Raven grins, wide and false. "The mountains? With your paws shaking like that? A man telling the truth doesn't stare at the rafters. We'll talk again." He leaves, and for the rest of the day you look over your shoulder every few steps.

nodes.lapowka.text.t: Raven counts the coins twice and slips them into his purse with the ease of a man who does it every day. "Fifteen? You know that won't make me forget you for good. But for a week I won't remember your mug." He leaves without looking back.

nodes.nie.text.t: "Don't like my kind? Plenty don't, and plenty pay. I'll remember your mug, newcomer." He walks out and slams the door.

nodes.powitanie.text.t: A broad-shouldered fellow sits at the counter in a cloak bearing no crest, a sword at his belt and the mug of a man who never pays for himself. He turns a tankard in his fist and stares at you too long. "New, are you? In holes like this you can spot a new face from the door."

nodes.pytanie.options.[klam].text.t: I know nothing, but I've heard things.

nodes.pytanie.options.[lap].text.t: I'll give you fifteen groats to leave me be.

nodes.pytanie.options.[nie].text.t: I don't talk to your kind.

nodes.pytanie.text.t: "I'm looking for a lad from the School of the Blade. Young, in a crumpled tunic in the school's colours, with that mark on the sleeve they used to wear. The Emperor pays proper. Twenty coins for a name, another twenty for a place. What do you say?"
